conclusions: gfx1151 N1 improves the clean current-main llama-compat control by 14.44% with identical full-suite semantics.
The production N3 complete-cycle adapter retains essentially all of N1: 80.099 versus 80.132 tok/s, a 0.042% difference.
Every train, heldout, and category row improves versus the clean control and beats its own true AR denominator.
The profiler is kernel-dominated at 87.1% with zero measured recaptures; the remaining target work is model kernels rather than Python submission residual.
N3P proposal-graph admission remains deferred because it was not the gfx1100 topline and is not required for the retained gfx1151 N3 win.
